sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽了心思来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: Warnings, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 关于警告事项，请查看您所用应用上的本期节目简介，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: Today's episode involves crimes against children, and won't be suitable for all listeners.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目涉及针对儿童的犯罪，并非适合所有听众。

sentences.en: Hello, Charlie Otero called out.
sentences.zh: “喂，”查理·奥特罗大声喊道。

sentences.en: Is anybody home?
sentences.zh: “家里有人吗？”

sentences.en: It was around 3.30pm on Tuesday January 15, 1974, and 15-year-old Charlie had just returned home from school.
sentences.zh: 那是1974年1月15日星期二下午3点半左右，15岁的查理刚放学回家。

sentences.en: The Otero family of seven lived on the corner of East Murdoch Avenue and North Edgemore Street, in the quiet eastern suburbs of Wichita, Kansas.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗一家七口住在堪萨斯州威奇托市东穆多克大道和北埃奇莫尔街的交汇处，那里是威奇托安静的东部郊区。

sentences.en: Their modest whitewood-framed bungalow should have been full of life that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，他们那栋简朴的白木框架平房本该充满生气。

sentences.en: 38-year-old patriarch Joe Otero was taking time off work as an airplane mechanic and flight instructor to recover from a car accident that had left him with several cracked ribs.
sentences.zh: 38岁的家长乔·奥特罗原本是一名飞机机械师兼飞行教员，他因一场车祸导致几根肋骨骨折，目前正请假在家休养。

sentences.en: His 33-year-old wife, Julie, had been temporarily laid off as an assembler at a camping equipment factory until business picked up again.
sentences.zh: 他33岁的妻子朱莉是一家露营设备厂的装配工，由于业务暂时清淡，她被临时裁员等待复工。

sentences.en: The couple's four youngest children, 9-year-old Joey, 11-year-old Josie, 13-year-old Carmen, and 14-year-old Danny should have been home from school by the time Charlie arrived.
sentences.zh: 当查理到家时，这对夫妇的四个最小的孩子——9岁的乔伊、11岁的乔西、13岁的卡门和14岁的丹尼——本应该已经放学回家了。

sentences.en: Instead, he was met with an inexplicable silence.
sentences.zh: 然而，迎面而来的却是一片莫名的寂静。

sentences.en: A few other things had struck him as odd.
sentences.zh: 还有一些其他的事让他觉得有些不对劲。

sentences.en: His mother's beige 1966 Oldsmobile Vista Cruiser station wagon was missing from the driveway,
sentences.zh: 他母亲那辆米色1966款奥兹莫比尔 Vista Cruiser 旅行车不在车道上，

sentences.en: but the garage door was wide open, allowing the blustery winter wind to sweep snow inside.
sentences.zh: 但车库门却大开着，呼啸的冬风把雪刮进了屋里。

sentences.en: Charlie figured she must have rushed out and forgotten to close it, though it was unlike his meticulous mother to be so careless.
sentences.zh: 查理猜想她一定是匆忙出门忘了关门，尽管这不像他一向细心的母亲那样大意。

sentences.en: He also noticed Lucky, the Otero's large, short-haired, brown, boxed dog had been left outside alone in the backyard.
sentences.zh: 他还注意到奥特罗家那只大体型、短毛、棕色、长相方正的狗——拉奇，被独自留在了后院外面。

sentences.en: Lucky disliked the cold and was usually only let out when guests visited, since he was protective and barked at strangers.
sentences.zh: 拉奇讨厌寒冷，平时只有在有客来访时才会被放出来，因为它很有防范意识，会对陌生人吠叫。

sentences.en: The inside of the Otero home appeared mostly neat and orderly, though several items were noticeably out of place.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗的家内部看起来大多整洁有序，不过有几样东西明显摆错了地方。

sentences.en: A gallon of milk had been left out on the kitchen sink's drain board, with the receiver of the wall-mounted telephone next to it.
sentences.zh: 厨房水槽的沥水板上留着一加仑牛奶，旁边放着壁挂式电话的听筒。

sentences.en: Open cans of fruit and meat spread were set out on the nearby table, next to a knife and an unsealed half-loaf of bread.
sentences.zh: 附近桌子上摆着打开的水果罐头和肉酱，旁边还有一把刀和半条没封口的切片面包。

sentences.en: Several slices had been smeared with the meat spread, a staple Julie often packed for her children's school lunches, though Josie's lunchbox was in the kitchen, empty.
sentences.zh: 几片面包上已经抹上了肉酱，这是朱莉经常为孩子们的学校午餐准备的主食，不过乔西的饭盒却空空如也地留在厨房里。

sentences.en: It appeared the family had abruptly vanished mid-breakfast, leaving behind several important belongings.
sentences.zh: 看起来这家人是在吃早饭吃到一半时突然消失的，留下了几件重要的随身物品。

sentences.en: Josie and Joey's winter coats were draped over a chair, and Joe's shoes were tucked under the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 乔西和乔伊的冬衣搭在椅子上，乔的鞋子塞在厨房餐桌底下。

sentences.en: Stranger still, Joe's wallet had been stripped of its contents and tossed on the stovetop, while Julie's brown leather purse lay upturned on the living room floor,
sentences.zh: 更奇怪的是，乔的钱包被掏空了里面的东西，随手扔在炉灶上，而朱莉的棕色皮包则底朝天地倒在客厅的地板上，

sentences.en: its belongings scattered across the carpet.
sentences.zh: 里面的东西散落在地毯上。

sentences.en: Julie Otero was a tidy woman.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·奥特罗是一个爱整洁的女人。

sentences.en: She would never have left her house in such disarray.
sentences.zh: 她绝不可能把家里弄得这么凌乱。

sentences.en: When Charlie called out asking if anyone was home, a sound emerged from deeper inside the house.
sentences.zh: 当查理大声询问有没有人在家时，屋子深处传出了一个声音。

sentences.en: It was the urgent and confused voice of one of his younger siblings.
sentences.zh: 那是他某个年幼弟弟妹妹急切而困惑的声音。

sentences.en: Charlie, they yelled.
sentences.zh: “查理，”他们喊道。

sentences.en: Mum and Dad are playing a bad trick on us.
sentences.zh: “爸爸妈妈在跟我们开恶劣的玩笑。”

sentences.en: Charlie bolted down the hallway and into his parents' bedroom.
sentences.zh: 查理冲过走廊，跑进父母的卧室。

sentences.en: There he found the eldest of his siblings, Danny and Carmen, who had arrived home together only moments earlier.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他找到了他的大龄兄姐丹尼和卡门，他们就在片刻前才刚刚一同回到家。

sentences.en: What they had stumbled upon hit Charlie with such crushing force that it felt as though his heart was being ripped from his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 他们所撞见的一幕给查理带来了毁灭性的沉重打击，让他感觉自己的心脏仿佛要被硬生生地从胸腔里扯出来。

sentences.en: Further along North Edgemore Street, local resident Del Johnson was shoveling snow outside his home when Danny Otero came running up to him in a panic.
sentences.zh: 在北埃奇莫尔街的另一头，当地居民德尔·约翰逊正在自家门外铲雪，这时丹尼·奥特罗惊慌失措地向他跑来。

sentences.en: The Oteros were relatively new to the neighbourhood, having purchased their home just 10 weeks earlier.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗一家搬到这个社区不久，他们十周前才刚买下这栋房子。

sentences.en: Though they hadn't yet fully settled in and were mostly homebound due to the frosty winter weather, the Oteros had already established themselves as a kind and happy family.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们还没完全安顿下来，而且因为寒冷的冬天气候大多足不出户，但奥特罗一家已经树立了善良、幸福家庭的形象。

sentences.en: They fit seamlessly into Wichita's carefree community of about 260,000 residents, where doors were kept unlocked and keys left in cars overnight.
sentences.zh: 他们完美地融入了威奇托无忧无虑的约26万居民社区中，在那里人们夜不闭户，车钥匙就直接留在车里。

sentences.en: To the honest, pious people of Wichita, a stranger was just a friend they hadn't met yet.
sentences.zh: 对于威奇托诚实、虔诚的人们来说，陌生人不过是还没结识的朋友。

sentences.en: Against this safe and idyllic backdrop,
sentences.zh: 在这样一个安全而田园诗般的环境背景下，

sentences.en: Del Johnson was stunned when Danny Otero gasped,
sentences.zh: 当丹尼·奥特罗气喘吁吁地说出这句话时，德尔·约翰逊惊呆了：

sentences.en: Come quick, my father's dead, I think.
sentences.zh: “快来，我爸爸好像死了。”

sentences.en: Del rushed to the Otero house and went inside.
sentences.zh: 德尔快步赶到奥特罗家并走了进去。

sentences.en: He approached the main bedroom belonging to Joe and Julie, only to stop short of the doorway.
sentences.zh: 他走到属于乔和朱莉的主卧室，却在门口停下了脚步。

sentences.en: Upon seeing what lay within, he carefully backed away and went to use the family's telephone to call the police, but the line was dead.
sentences.zh: 看到眼前的景象后，他小心翼翼地退了回去，打算用家里的电话报警，但电话线已经断了。

sentences.en: He then ran home and contacted authorities from there.
sentences.zh: 于是他跑回自己家，从那里联系了当局。

sentences.en: Two officers arrived on the scene minutes later.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，两名警官赶到了现场。

sentences.en: As their cruiser pulled up,
sentences.zh: 正当他们的警车停下时，

sentences.en: Charlie Otero barrelled toward them, frantically explaining that his parents were in the house and had been tied up.
sentences.zh: 查理·奥特罗飞奔过去，歇斯底里地解释说他的父母在屋里而且被绑起来了。

sentences.en: Charlie was instructed to stay outside with his two siblings as the officers entered the home.
sentences.zh: 警官们进入屋内时，指示查理和他的两个兄姐留在外面。

sentences.en: They proceeded down the hallway to the main bedroom and pushed the ajar door wide open.
sentences.zh: 他们顺着走廊来到主卧室，把半掩着的房门用力推开。

sentences.en: Joe Otero lay face up on the floor at the foot of the bed, his face bruised and streaked with the dried blood from his nose and mouth.
sentences.zh: 乔·奥特罗仰面躺在床脚的地板上，他的脸上有淤青，鼻口处沾满了干涸的血迹。

sentences.en: His ankles were bound tightly with white cotton braided cord.
sentences.zh: 他的脚踝被一根白色的棉质编织绳紧紧捆住。

sentences.en: Although his hands were loose, his wrists featured deep-patterned impressions showing they had also been restrained at one point and he had struggled fiercely to break free.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的双手没有被捆绑，但他的手腕上有深深的勒痕，表明他曾一度也被捆绑过，而且他曾拼死挣扎以图挣脱。

sentences.en: Similar marks encircled his neck.
sentences.zh: 他的脖子上也有类似的勒痕环绕。

sentences.en: Julie Otero lay on her back on the nearby bed.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·奥特罗仰面躺在附近的床上。

sentences.en: She was fully clothed, with her wrists bound behind her back and her ankles tied together.
sentences.zh: 她衣着完整，手腕被反绑在身后，脚踝也被绑在一起。

sentences.en: She had also been beaten.
sentences.zh: 她也遭到过殴打。

sentences.en: Beside her head was a blood-stained white cloth gag and lengths of white cord.
sentences.zh: 在她头部旁边是一块沾满血迹的白色布条口塞和几段白色的绳子。

sentences.en: Both the Joe and Julie were cold and without a pulse.
sentences.zh: 乔和朱莉都已经浑身冰凉且没有了脉搏。

sentences.en: The officers radioed dispatch to report the grisly discovery before returning outside to the three eldest Otero children.
sentences.zh: 警官们用无线电向调度中心报告了这一骇人听闻的发现，然后返回屋外找到了奥特罗家的三个大孩子。

sentences.en: Within minutes, it seemed as if the entire Wichita police force had descended on the quiet suburban street, joined shortly after by members of the press and curious onlookers.
sentences.zh: 几分钟之内，威奇托警察局的警力似乎倾巢出动来到了这条安静的郊区街道，紧随其后的是媒体记者和好奇的旁观者。

sentences.en: The police were unusually tight-lipped, prompting reporters to conclude that whatever they had found inside the Otero house must have been truly horrific.
sentences.zh: 警方异常口风严密，这让记者们断定，他们在奥特罗屋内发现的东西一定极其可怕。

sentences.en: As the crime scene was being cordoned off,
sentences.zh: 在犯罪现场被拉起警戒线的同时，

sentences.en: Charlie, Danny and Carmen were escorted to a police station to give their accounts of the day's advance.
sentences.zh: 查理、丹尼和卡门被护送到警察局，以陈述他们对这一天经过的所见所闻。

sentences.en: From the moment the trio were woken up by their mother that morning, everything seemed routine and normal.
sentences.zh: 从那天早上被母亲唤醒的那一刻起，一切似乎都按部就班、平平常常。

sentences.en: At 7.50am,
sentences.zh: 早上7点50分，

sentences.en: Joe drove Charlie, Danny and Carmen to school in his wife's station wagon as his car still needed repairs following his recent accident.
sentences.zh: 乔开着他妻子的旅行车送查理、丹尼和卡门去学校，因为他的车在最近的车祸后仍需要修理。

sentences.en: When Charlie went to close the garage door, his father told him to leave it open, explaining that he would return straight home to take Joey and Josie to elementary school.
sentences.zh: 当查理去关车库门时，他父亲让他开着门，并解释说他会直接回家带乔伊和乔西去小学。

sentences.en: Because the family were down to the one car,
sentences.zh: 由于家里只剩下一辆车，

sentences.en: Charlie, Danny and Carmen had to walk the two miles home from school in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 查理、丹尼和卡门下午不得不步行两英里回家。

sentences.en: Danny and Carmen walked home together and arrived firSt.
sentences.zh: 丹尼和卡门一起步行回家，并且最先到达。

sentences.en: The Oteros used the rear door as their main family entrance, reserving the front for guests and visitors.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗一家通常把后门作为主要的家庭出入口，正门则留给宾客和访客。

sentences.en: As the siblings approached the wooden gate leading into the backyard, they found Lucky outside in the cold.
sentences.zh: 当兄姐二人走近通往后院的木门时，他们发现拉奇被关在冰冷的室外。

sentences.en: The house itself was eerily silent and still.
sentences.zh: 房子里安静得透着诡异和死寂。

sentences.en: Danny and Carmen noticed their mother's purse and father's wallet ransacked and tossed aside, then made their way to their parents' bedroom.
sentences.zh: 丹尼和卡门发现母亲的钱包和父亲的钱包被搜得乱七八糟并扔在一旁，接着他们走向父母的卧室。

sentences.en: Joe was face down on the floor with his hands bound behind his back and his feet tied to a bedpoSt.
sentences.zh: 乔脸朝下趴在地板上，双手被反绑在身后，双脚被绑在床柱上。

sentences.en: A plastic bag was constricted over his head.
sentences.zh: 他的头上套着一个塑料袋。

sentences.en: Danny tore it open before retrieving a kitchen knife to cut through the cords that bound his father.
sentences.zh: 丹尼撕开塑料袋，然后拿来一把厨房小刀割断了捆绑父亲的绳索。

sentences.en: He then rolled Joe over.
sentences.zh: 接着他把乔翻过身来。

sentences.en: A brown belt was taut around his neck along with more cord.
sentences.zh: 一条棕色皮带和更多的绳子紧紧勒在他的脖子上。

sentences.en: Danny struggled to loosen it all.
sentences.zh: 丹尼费了好大劲才把它们全部解松。

sentences.en: Nearby, Carmen removed the gag from her mother's mouth and cut the cord tightly wound around her neck using a pair of toenail clippers.
sentences.zh: 在附近，卡门用一把指甲刀取下了塞在她母亲嘴里的口塞，并割断了紧紧缠在她脖子上的绳子。

sentences.en: She and Danny attempted to perform CPR on their parents, but they didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 她和丹尼试图对父母实施心肺复苏术，但父母没有任何反应。

sentences.en: Danny tried calling the police from the kitchen telephone, but there was no dial tone.
sentences.zh: 丹尼试图用厨房电话报警，但没有拨号音。

sentences.en: He rushed downstairs to a second phone in the dark, unfinished basement, only to find that it wasn't working either.
sentences.zh: 他急忙跑下楼到昏暗、未完工的地下室的第二部电话旁，结果发现那部电话也无法使用。

sentences.en: Charlie arrived soon after and managed to remove the belt from his father's neck, noticing Joe's tongue was half bit off and he had vomited.
sentences.zh: 查理随后赶到，设法解下了父亲脖子上的皮带，他注意到乔的舌头被咬断了一半，而且呕吐过。

sentences.en: Believing the assailant might still be in the house,
sentences.zh: 由于以为袭击者可能还在屋里，

sentences.en: Charlie grabbed a knife and shouted,
sentences.zh: 查理抓起一把刀大喊道：

sentences.en: Whoever's in this house, you're dead.
sentences.zh: “不管屋里是谁，你死定了。”

sentences.en: No one responded.
sentences.zh: 没有人回应。

sentences.en: He tried the kitchen telephone himself, but it still wasn't working.
sentences.zh: 他亲自试了试厨房的电话，但依然无法使用。

sentences.en: Danny ran outside to seek help and encountered his neighbour,
sentences.zh: 丹尼跑出屋外寻求帮助并遇到了邻居

sentences.en: Del Johnson, who ultimately summoned the police.
sentences.zh: 德尔·约翰逊，由他最终报了警。

sentences.en: For Charlie, his biggest concern was his youngest siblings,
sentences.zh: 对查理来说，他最担心的是他最小的弟弟妹妹，

sentences.en: Joey and Josie.
sentences.zh: 乔伊和乔西。

sentences.en: They hadn't arrived home from school yet and would have no idea of the horror that awaited them when they did.
sentences.zh: 他们还没放学回家，根本不知道等待他们的是何等可怕的噩梦。

sentences.en: As their protective older brother, he begged the police over and over to prevent the young pair from coming home to spare them the trauma of seeing what had happened
sentences.zh: 作为他们具有保护欲的大哥，他一次又一次地恳求警方阻止两个年幼的孩子回家，以免他们遭受目睹父母

sentences.en: to their parents.
sentences.zh: 遭遇不幸时的精神创伤。

sentences.en: Eventually, a detective pulled Charlie aside and said gravely,
sentences.zh: 最终，一名侦探把查理拉到一旁，神情凝重地说道：

sentences.en: Charlie, we got to tell you.
sentences.zh: “查理，我们必须告诉你。”

sentences.en: Joey and Josie were in the house.
sentences.zh: “乔伊和乔西当时就在屋里。”

sentences.en: The youngest Otero child, nine-year-old Joey, was found in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 奥特罗家最小的孩子、九岁的乔伊被发现在他的卧室里。

sentences.en: He lay prone on the floor beside a bed, his wrists and ankles bound with the same white cord that was used to restrain his parents.
sentences.zh: 他面朝下趴在床边的地板上，手腕和脚踝被捆绑着他父母的同款白色绳索捆住。

sentences.en: A t-shirt, plastic bag and another t-shirt had been secured over his head and a length of cord was taut around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他的头上套着一件 T 恤、一个塑料袋和另一件 T 恤，脖子上紧紧勒着一段绳子。

sentences.en: While already a horrific scene, what homicide detectives discovered next left them with a chilling image that would haunt them for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 虽然这已经是一个极其可怕的犯罪现场，但凶杀案侦探们接下来发现的东西给他们留下了挥之不去的阴影，将困扰他们一生。
